priorityList.notes: Arcane Power on cooldown: a flat 30 percent damage cooldown with no cast time of its own.
Presence of Mind on cooldown: free (no GCD) and makes the next cast instant.
Missile Barrage is the talent proc that empowers your next Arcane Missiles cast -- fire the empowered Missiles under it, where the Arcane guide places the payoff.
Arcane Blast is learned at level 20 and gains new ranks through level 60 -- always cast your current highest learned rank.

Arcane Missiles is your filler before you have learned Arcane Blast and Missile Barrage -- the classic Arcane rotation from before Arcane Blast existed was itself Missiles spam. Cast your highest learned rank.
Shoot with your wand once mana falls under 20%: it costs nothing and keeps damage going while you regenerate, and Wand Specialization adds to it.
